    Learning English online Your success in the hands of professionals

    To meet the needs of our students, we rely on the best English language experts. Fluentbe teachers - they are our greatest asset.

    Create a free account Meet the teachers

    Experts at your service

    Your learning takes place online, giving you access to over 1,000 great teachers, including native speakers from all corners of the world.

    Thanks to this diversity, we can match the teacher to each student's preferences in terms of background, accent, experience of teaching at a particular level or specialist industry language.

    Teachers with experience

    Fluentbe teachers are qualified teachers of English who have a degree in English philology, linguistics or a teacher's college. In the case of native speakers, we require additional education related to teaching English as a foreign language, such as holding CELTA, DELTA, TEFL certificates.

    An injection of knowledge and motivation

    We work only with teachers who have charisma and the ability to interest their students in the subject. Each lesson is a source of new knowledge and motivation. Our teachers moderate the meetings in such a way that each student actively participates in the conversation and gets the most out of the lesson.

    Frequently asked questions

    Fluentbe's online English school operates in an innovative way, allowing students to learn English effectively anywhere, anytime. Fluentbe operates on an online platform, which allows students to access courses and materials virtually 24/7. No matter where they are, they can freely use the educational resources.

    The school works with qualified teachers, graduates of English philology, linguistics and from other specializations. In addition, it offers native speakers who provide authentic English language experience. Students can fit their learning into their daily schedule. No physical attendance is required, allowing students to study at their convenience, without time or geographic constraints.

    Learning is based on practical exercises, conversations and assignments that allow direct application of the language in real-life situations, which accelerates the mastery of communication skills. Fluentbe regularly evaluates students' progress, providing them with the ability to track their language development and motivating them to continue learning. With its flexible and modern approach, Fluentbe makes it possible to effectively learn English in a way that is affordable and accessible to everyone, regardless of their level or location.

    Getting started with Fluentbe is easy and straightforward. Here are some steps to help you get started: Register on the Platform: Go to the Fluentbe website and register your account. You will need to enter your personal information and select your preferred English course. Leave a contact: Leave your contact information for our Language Advisor, who will help you choose the right package for you.

    Choosing a Way of Learning: Decide whether you want to study individually or in small groups. Fluentbe offers both individual and group classes, depending on your preferences.

    Initial Interview: Before the course begins, a short introductory interview may be conducted to determine your language level and to tailor the course, teacher and materials to your needs.

    Course Start: Once you have registered and selected a course, you can start learning. You can access learning materials and classes through Fluentbe's online platform.

    Progress Tracking: Fluentbe regularly monitors your progress and provides feedback so you can track your performance and continue your language development.

    Getting started with Fluentbe allows you to reap the benefits of a flexible schedule, tailoring the course to your needs and learning under the guidance of qualified teachers. All this makes learning English effective and enjoyable.

    At Fluentbe, course offerings are rich and varied to meet the different needs and goals of students. Here are the main types of courses offered by Fluentbe:

    Business English: A course aimed at those who need specialized English for professional purposes, such as negotiating, making presentations, writing reports or conducting meetings.

    General English: This course provides a comprehensive study of English, developing all skills: reading, writing, speaking and listening, so that students can communicate freely in a variety of life situations.

    Specialized Courses: For those who want to improve their English in a specific area, Fluentbe offers a variety of specialized courses to gain specific vocabulary and confidence in conversations on selected topics.

    Exam Preparation Courses: If you have an important language exam ahead of you, Fluentbe provides courses specifically designed to study and prepare you for specific language exams.

    All courses at Fluentbe are online, giving you flexibility in your study schedule and allowing you to study from anywhere. Courses are taught by qualified teachers as well as native speakers, ensuring an authentic English language experience.

    With this variety and flexibility, Fluentbe provides effective and accessible solutions for people with different levels, learning goals and preferences.
